title: Rupee Falls 14 Paise to Close at 95.22 Against US Dollar
summary: The Indian rupee fell 14 paise to close at 95.22 against the US dollar on Friday, amid rising global oil prices and geopolitical tensions. The rupee opened lower at 95.28 against the US dollar, impacted by a robust dollar, escalating US Treasury yields, and elevated dollar demand from importers. Market watchers await the US jobs report for insights into monetary policy and currency direction.
summary_points: The Indian rupee fell 14 paise to close at 95.22 against the US dollar on Friday.
Rising global oil prices and geopolitical tensions contributed to the decline.
The rupee opened lower at 95.28 against the US dollar, impacted by a robust dollar and escalating US Treasury yields.
Elevated dollar demand from importers also contributed to the decline.
Market watchers await the US jobs report for insights into monetary policy and currency direction.
